title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-michael-chen-sophia-li
summary: Prep notes for 1:1 with Sophia. Focus: upcoming renewal for BoxHope, Q2 health metrics, deal support requests, and action items for enablement and collateral.
body:
Context:
- 1:1 with Sophia Li (SE/CS blended role) to align on high-priority accounts, unblock technical asks, and plan pre-renewal activities.
- Main account to discuss: BoxHope (Enterprise, Dedicated trial ended June). Renewal window: 2026-08-15.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick sync (5m) — personal check-in, capacity for next 2 weeks
2) BoxHope status (10m) — technical blockers, usage trends, cost concerns
3) Renewal strategy (8m) — pricing negotiation posture, exec sponsor outreach, demo plan
4) Enablement & collateral (5m) — what Sophia needs from product/SE/marketing

Prep notes / data points to reference:
- BoxHope telemetry: API calls down 12% MoM, token spend up 18% (embedding-heavy flows).
- Reported latency incidents: 2 minor timeouts in June (ticket RED-5698) during batch reranking. Needs SRE follow-up and mitigation plan.
- Support requests outstanding: PR-318 (quantization compatibility for custom model), SE-ask for sample load test harness.
- Renewal ARR: $145k ARR (annualized), expansion opportunity: +$40k for multi-region redundancy + priority SLA.
- Exec sponsor: CTO = Maya Thompson; key champion: Head of ML = Carlos Ruiz.

Talking points / questions for Sophia:
- What are the live customer objections around performance vs. cost? Any fresh pushback after the Dedicated trial?
- For the quantization work (PR-318), what blocking steps need to happen this week to unblock their infra team?
- Can we get a short list of 2-3 success metrics BoxHope will use to justify renewal (e.g., p50 latency, cost per 1M tokens, inference throughput)?
- Who on BoxHope (technical contact) can we engage for a joint runbook/war-room for the first-week-of-commit?

Immediate action items (who, what, due):
- Sophia Li: coordinate a 60-min joint run with BoxHope infra + our SREs to reproduce timeout (target window: 2026-07-10). Due: 2026-07-09.
- Michael Chen (me): Draft renewal play with three options (standard, discounted + multi-region, commercial pilot for SLA). Share v1 to Sophia. Due: 2026-07-12.
- Avery Chen: Provide SE sample load-test harness and quickstart docs (linked PR/zip). Due: 2026-07-11.
- Product/Serving runtime: Investigate RED-5698 root cause & propose short-term mitigation (circuit-breaker or retry policy). Notify me by 2026-07-10.

Longer-term / Follow-ups:
- Create a one-pager for BoxHope highlighting cost/capacity levers (batching, cache policies, quant profiles) we can present to the CTO during renewal. Owner: Michael. Due: 2026-07-20.
- Post-renewal success plan: 30/60/90 day milestones and an onboarding checklist for Dedicated customers. Owner: Sophia + CS ops. Draft by 2026-07-30.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: Customer churn if cost keeps increasing and latency regressions continue.
  Mitigation: Offer temporary discount if they commit to multi-region + staged rollout; commit SRE time for month 1.
- Risk: SE bandwidth limited causing delayed fixes.
  Mitigation: Prioritize PR-318 and scope a minimal compatibility shim.

Notes to self (things to mention verbally):
- Emphasize Redwood's fallback policies and recent runtime fixes that reduce tail latency (cite internal SRE patch v2.1.4).
- Ask Sophia whether she has a preferred format for the renewal deck (technical appendix vs. business case first).
- Remind to follow up on demo environment provisioning time — set expectation of 48-72h for Dedicated staging.

Slack threads / refs to pull during the call:
- #cs-boxhope-thread (recent customer escalations)
- RED-5698 (Jira)
- Confluence: Account Playbook > BoxHope notes

Post-1:1 follow-up template (to send within 24h):
- TL;DR summary of decisions and owners
- Attach renewal play v1 + one-pager (if ready)
- Confirm runbook schedule and invite list

Quick wins to propose on the call:
- Short-term: Enable request-based batching for their reranking pipeline (low-effort config change)
- Medium-term: Trial multi-region routing for a subset of traffic to test latency improvements

Open questions for exec escalation if needed:
- Can we offer a 3-month SLA-backed pilot for a reduced fee to prove reliability? Who signs off on that?
- Is a special SRE rotation for strategic renewals in scope this quarter?

End-of-doc: remind to add meeting notes after the 1:1 and update action item statuses.
